title: jatropha angustifolia var. glauca
intro: Jatropha angustifolia var. glauca, commonly known as the "Guanacaste" or "Palo de Agua", is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it is used to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, fever, and skin problems, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Jatropha angustifolia var. glauca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents present in the plant contribute to its therapeutic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
